franchise: Stella Deus: The Gate of Eternity
summary: A one-off PlayStation 2 tactical RPG from Atlus and Pinegrow with a painterly style and grid-based battles.

entries.title: Stella Deus: The Gate of Eternity

emulation.notes: Use internal-resolution scaling and verify text/UI readability after any graphics hacks.

primary.why: The PlayStation 2 release is the only documented platform version, and PCSX2 upscaling provides the highest-fidelity capture path.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PS2 disc image in PCSX2 with a high internal resolution, texture filtering as preferred, and the original aspect ratio unless a verified widescreen patch is chosen.
